title: cistus × laxus var. nigrescens
intro: Cistus × laxus var. nigrescens, commonly known as Black Rockrose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus, characterized by its dark green, glossy leaves and fragrant, dark pink to purple flowers. Traditionally, this plant has been used to support respiratory health, with potential benefits including relief from coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Cistus × laxus var. nigrescens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe irritated tissues and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, as well as terpenes and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
